name: Cybergoth
reacts_against: traditional goth's all-black, candlelit romanticism, injecting it with rave-era UV neon and visible technology (goggles, LEDs, fiber optics).

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Synthetic dreadfalls (cyberlox), goggles, gas masks, biohazard symbols, circuit patterns, platform boots, PVC and vinyl clothing
wiki_facts.key_colours: Black contrasted with bright neon or UV-reactive colors (green, pink, blue, orange)
wiki_facts.key_values: Futurism, technology, dystopian themes, electronic music, club culture, individuality

findings: dark — about 60% of the measured color across 6 wiki images is below mid-lightness
mostly muted — about 75% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Aesthetics Wiki photos as photographed and displayed on screen; actual garments and materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
